evidence.notes: Active rows rejected by emptyRecycleBin return ENTITY_IS_NOT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN through the result and Database.Error accessors.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDmlRowActionErrorDetailsTest { @isTest static void emptyRecycleBinActiveRowsExposeDatabaseErrors() { Account active = new Account(Name = 'Active'); insert active; Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult result = Database.emptyRecycleBin(active, false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(active.Id, result.getId()); System.assertEquals(1, result.getErrors().size()); Object error = result.getErrors().get(0); System.assertEquals('ENTITY_IS_NOT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN', error.getStatusCode()); System.assert(error.getMessage().contains('not in the recycle bin')); System.assertEquals(0, error.getFields().size()); System.assertEquals(0, error.getExtendedErrorDetails().size()); } }
